title: Memo
description: memos/<id>.json: one letter (displayed so; the id is `memo` because `letter` names the handover letter in the code) that a character wrote in the Memos section of its handover letter, one line per memo: `- <kind>: <text> refs: <path>, <path>`. The Steward reads that section when an assignee's run ends through a submit, a question or a crash (not a breaker), files each memo here with an id made from the quest, the kind and the normalized text, so reading the letter again files nothing twice, and routes it by its kind's entry in registry/memos.json (ADR 0024). Characters never write this folder. A memo changes no quest's state and is never answered: it is decided once and closed, by the owner (decide_memo, `elvaria memo decide`, or confirming a draft made from it) or, within kingdom.delegation, by the Chancellor's triage (PS-03b); a memo the triage sends to the owner keeps its advice in `escalation`.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Events: memo.filed, memo.routed, memo.closed. Not expressible here: state = closed exactly when outcome is present; outcome.quest is required when outcome.decision = handled; the id's day is the day in the quest's id.

from.description: The character whose letter held the memo.

quest.description: The quest whose handover letter held the memo.

attempt.description: The quest's run whose session ended with the memo in its letter.

to.description: The recipient, decided by routeMemo from the registry (ADR 0024). Later routes add their own fields (the quests of an advisory, the second judge of an objection).

route.description: Where the memo goes, from its kind's entry in registry/memos.json.

refs.description: Files the memo is about, relative to the plot, as the character wrote them ('/' separators).

outcome.description: How the memo was closed: by decide_memo, or handled by the quest a create_quest or edit_quest naming it made or changed (PS-03b).

quest.description: With decision = handled: the quest that does the work.

escalation.description: The Chancellor's triage sent the memo to the owner with its advice (PS-03b, escalate_memo): kingdom.delegation does not let the world decide it. The memo stays open until decided; the next triage leaves it alone.

action.description: What the Chancellor would do with the memo.

quest.description: merge: the open quest it would take the memo in; new_quest: the draft quest made for the owner to confirm.

addendum.description: merge: what the quest's description would gain.

holds.description: Why the owner decides (delegationHolds): the matters it keeps and the limits found.

examples.body: `elvaria quest list` in giờ theo UTC; nên dùng múi giờ của vương quốc như `quest show`.
